p_criteria_hard.instructions: Is there an animal or bird anywhere in this photo, even small, far away, dark or at the edge?

criteria.true: an animal or bird, or any part of one (eyes, legs, tail, body), is visible, including blurred, distant or infrared-lit ones
criteria.false: only vegetation, ground, rocks, sky, shadows, or camera artefacts such as glare, rain, dust or motion blur

p_empty_inverted.instructions: Is this photo empty, showing only the background scene?

criteria.true: only vegetation, ground, sky, or camera artefacts; no animal, person or vehicle
criteria.false: an animal, person or vehicle, or part of one, is visible

e_criteria.instructions: Is there a person or a vehicle in this photo?

criteria.true: a person, car, truck, motorbike or other vehicle, or part of one, is visible
criteria.false: only animals, vegetation, ground, sky, or camera artefacts

e_human_activity.instructions: Is there any sign of people in this photo: a person, a vehicle, or headlights?

criteria.true: a person, a vehicle, or vehicle headlights are visible
criteria.false: only animals and the natural scene

difficulty.instructions: How easy is the subject to see?

criteria.clear: the subject is large, lit and in focus
criteria.hard: the subject is small, dark, blurred, infrared or partly hidden

frozen.method: Tuning set only. Wording: highest AUC (escalation ties broken by the widest gap between classes). skip_below: highest 0.01 grid value with zero tuning animals scoring below it (miss budget 0; lowest animal score 0.376). small_above: midpoint of the gap between the highest-scoring empty frame Decider called clear (0.347) and the lowest-scoring clear animal frame above it (0.888). escalate_above: midpoint of the gap between the highest non-person/vehicle frame (0.332) and the lowest person/vehicle frame (0.741), labels audited by eye where CCT marks people as empty.
